title: Practice-to-Proof Learning Lab
environment: Authorized course sandbox plus disposable local lab
risk_cost: Low; no cloud spend. Do not copy course answers, flags, or credentials.
goal: Turn external study into independently reproduced, verifiable evidence.
verification: Task reproduced without following a solution
cleanup: Follow the selected practical's cleanup steps and remove temporary evidence containing sensitive data.

title: Linux Host Incident Response Lab
environment: Local Linux host; synthetic logs copied to a temporary directory
risk_cost: Low; no root, network, cloud account, or host service changes.
goal: Triage a synthetic service incident using host observations and a tested JSONL analyzer.
verification: Release/minute error and latency summaries match fixture
cleanup: Remove only the generated devops-linux-lab temporary directory using the guide's path guard.

title: Production-Ready Container Image Lab
environment: Local Docker Engine, loopback published port only
risk_cost: Low; no registry push, Docker socket mount, credentials, or cloud account.
goal: Build, inspect, and run a tested non-root image with runtime restrictions.
verification: UID 10001, read-only root filesystem, limits, and 404 behavior verified
cleanup: Stop the exact image-lab container; --rm removes it. Avoid broad prune commands.

title: Kubernetes Architecture and etcd
prerequisites: Disposable control-plane cluster for hands-on restore work
environment: Read-only design exercise; snapshot/restore only in an isolated distribution-matched cluster
risk_cost: High if etcd commands are misapplied; managed control planes require provider procedures.
goal: Trace request handling and produce a tested, topology-specific etcd recovery plan.
cleanup: Follow distribution cleanup; securely remove synthetic snapshots after the exercise.

title: RBAC and Namespace Isolation
environment: Disposable Kubernetes cluster; manifests scoped to lab namespaces
risk_cost: Medium; verify cluster context before applying RBAC changes.
goal: Prove read-only access boundaries and identify inherited grants.
verification: Expected kubectl auth can-i checks match
cleanup: Delete only lab namespace/RBAC objects after verification.

title: Liveness, Readiness, and Startup Probes
environment: Disposable cluster and sample workload only
risk_cost: Low in a lab; do not inject failures into shared environments.
goal: Distinguish restart signals from readiness and dependency failures.
verification: Pod events and restart count captured
Readiness endpoint and service routing observed
cleanup: Remove the lab namespace and workloads.

title: Autoscaling: HPA, VPA, and Cluster Autoscaler
environment: Load only against an owned sample service in a disposable cluster
risk_cost: Potential resource spend; define load budget and clean up.
goal: Observe metrics, replica scaling, scheduling, and capacity constraints.
verification: Scheduling events and node capacity explained
cleanup: Stop load generator and delete all lab workloads/resources.

title: Air-Gapped Kubernetes Deployment
environment: Planning exercise or approved isolated offline lab
risk_cost: Medium; transfer only approved artifacts through controlled channels.
goal: Build a complete offline dependency inventory, validation, and rollback plan.
cleanup: Follow organization retention and secure artifact deletion policy.

title: CKA Domain Practice Map
environment: Study map; choose disposable environments for referenced practicals
risk_cost: Low; this is a curriculum crosswalk, not an official exam blueprint.
goal: Identify covered Kubernetes domains and select safe practice for the gaps.
cleanup: Follow the selected lab cleanup instructions.

title: Storage Lab: PV, PVC, and Pod Replacement
environment: Disposable single-node Kind cluster with static hostPath PV
risk_cost: Lab data is node-local and deleted with the Kind cluster; not production storage.
goal: Verify PVC binding and persistence across Deployment-managed Pod replacement.
cleanup: Delete only the named storage-lab Kind cluster; retained hostPath data is not backup.

title: Multi-Node Scheduling Lab
environment: Disposable three-node Kind cluster
risk_cost: Low; all labels/taints exist only in the named lab cluster.
goal: Diagnose Pending Pods using node selectors, taints, tolerations, and events.
verification: Initial Pod lands on general worker
Tolerated Pod lands on reserved worker
cleanup: Delete only the scheduling-lab Kind cluster.

title: Helm Release Lifecycle Lab
environment: Disposable Kind cluster and local chart
risk_cost: Low; no third-party chart repository or credentials required.
goal: Lint, render, install, upgrade, inspect history, rollback, and uninstall a chart.
cleanup: Uninstall named release and delete only helm-lab cluster.

title: Cluster Maintenance Lab
environment: Kind drain exercise plus separate kubeadm-on-VM upgrade plan
risk_cost: Drain only the named lab. Kubeadm track requires disposable VMs and version-specific procedures.
goal: Practice cordon/drain/uncordon with a PDB and produce a supported version upgrade rehearsal plan.
cleanup: Delete only maintenance-lab cluster; VM cleanup follows the sandbox provider procedure.

title: Cluster Troubleshooting Lab
environment: Disposable three-node Kind cluster; stops only a named Kind worker container
risk_cost: Node stop is disruptive; use only troubleshooting-lab, then restart the node immediately.
goal: Diagnose and recover image-pull, Service selector, and worker heartbeat failures.
verification: Distinct evidence identifies each failed layer
Two Pods and Service endpoints restored
cleanup: Restart the worker after the failure drill, then delete only the troubleshooting-lab cluster.

title: End-to-End Release Lab
environment: Disposable Kind; staging and production are separate namespaces
risk_cost: Low when using only the named lab cluster and exercise branch.
goal: Promote one image, observe two controlled failures, diagnose from evidence, and recover by Git revert.
cleanup: Delete only release-lab Kind cluster; do not target an existing cluster.

title: Argo CD Monitoring Lab
prerequisites: Git repository reachable by Argo CD
environment: Disposable two-node Kind cluster; pinned Argo CD and Prometheus/Grafana charts
risk_cost: Resource intensive; chart/image downloads; never use production kubeconfig.
goal: Install Argo CD and monitoring, verify metrics targets/dashboard/alerts, then recover a GitOps failure.
verification: Alert rules load and failure/revert is observed
cleanup: Stop port-forwards and delete only argocd-monitoring Kind cluster.

title: Private ARC Runner Image Lab
environment: Dedicated or strongly isolated cluster; private custom runner image package
risk_cost: High security sensitivity; runner jobs execute arbitrary code with network reachability.
goal: Build/publish image variants, deploy ARC scale set, run trusted smoke workflow, and diagnose image pull failure.
verification: Ephemeral runner executes trusted workflow and disappears
cleanup: Uninstall runner scale set first; remove controller only if no other scale sets use it; revoke lab credentials if exposed.

title: Production AI Assistant Capstone
domain: privacy-aware AI service design and operations
environment: Fictional design/tabletop; no provider credentials, customer data, cloud provisioning, or spend.
risk_cost: No infrastructure cost. Real implementation requires provider/privacy/security review.
goal: Design a human-reviewed assistant with SLO, evaluation, privacy, cost limits, failure handling, and rollback.
verification: Failure inject has detection, mitigation, owner, and recovery verification
cleanup: No resources provisioned; retain only fictional design notes.

title: Production Incident and Change Review Tabletop
environment: Fictional tabletop only; no system changes or customer data.
risk_cost: No infrastructure cost or operational change.
goal: Coordinate a canary incident, recover safely, review a risky change, and create systemic actions.
verification: Status updates and recovery criteria written
cleanup: No resources created; remove any internal notes containing sensitive details before sharing.

title: Multi-Cluster GitOps Troubleshooting
environment: Read-only diagnostic scenario; no live cluster mutation required.
risk_cost: Low; do not bypass production review or alter production directly.
goal: Diagnose why staging is healthy while production fails to sync or become healthy.
verification: Revision, render, destination, authorization, dependencies, and external inputs compared
cleanup: No resources created.

title: Git Branching and Release Recovery Exercise
environment: Throwaway local Git repository.
risk_cost: Low when performed in a disposable repo; never rewrite shared history for production recovery.
goal: Compare revert, prior-artifact redeploy, and forward fix with compatibility and communication constraints.
cleanup: Delete only the throwaway repository.
